opportunity_candidates.reason: Existing page plus direct ranking underperformance, strong commercial indicators, clear bounded delivery, and relatively low overclaim risk.
Direct ranking evidence exists, but actual 24/7 availability must be verified.

selection.selection_reason: The Invisalign opportunity has a specific evidenced deficiency on an existing high-value service page, high commercial indicators, and a clear freelancer delivery path without requiring unsupported claims.

validation_rules_applied: The LLM selected only from supplied candidate IDs.
Existing strength alone was not accepted as the primary sellable opportunity.
Competitor-brand terms were separated from relevant demand.
The report acknowledges strengths and limitations.
No lost-revenue, guaranteed-ranking, lead, booking, or causation claims were allowed.
known_pipeline_issues: The first run parsed the keyword-ideas response incorrectly; the parser was fixed and the complete pipeline rerun.
The Google Ads keywords-for-site output is broad and noisy; production needs deterministic pre-filtering before LLM classification.
OpenAI token usage and cost were not captured.
The run took 279.35 seconds and should not be implemented as a synchronous customer request without revisiting execution design.
The screenshot was user-supplied rather than captured automatically.
